text:
alex.p: Quick sync — Orbit Labs (reseller) is asking for an 18% reseller margin across dev/pro tiers + a 10% MDF credit for onboarding. They want this reflected on annual commits. Need deal-desk approval. Link to request: https://redwood.internal/partners/requests/ORB-2026 :eyes:

priya.s: @alex.p what's the ACV / expected volume? 18% seems high unless there's a commit.

alex.p: They projected ~$120k ARR first year, ramping to 300k by year 2. Asking for 12 month commit, opt-out on renewal unless 60d notice.

jenn a.se: small correction — they'll run a 4-week POC that needs private VPC onboarding and a short security questionnaire completed before sandbox access. I flagged SCQ to security.

jenna.se: also note they want co-branded marketing (MDF use-case) — that's where MDF ask comes in.

martin.dealdesk: @alex.p can you drop the proposed rate card here and confirm whether this is exclusive to Orbit or open channel? Need to model margin impact.

alex.p: sure — proposed:
```
Proposed partner pricing (USD/month)
- Dev Tier: list price 1,500 -> partner price 1,230 (18% margin)
- Pro Tier: list price 5,000 -> partner price 4,100 (18% margin)
- MDF: 10% rebate on first-year bookings (applies to ARR up to 200k)
- Commit: minimum 100k ARR, 12 months
- Exclusivity: none
```

claire.finance: 18% on list hurts revenue unless we claw back via MDF or marketing co-fund. Need net unit economics. @martin.dealdesk can you run a quick P&L: gross margin vs COGS after partner cut + MDF?

martin.dealdesk: will do. quick Q: do we treat MDF as prepaid credit or a rebate applied after invoicing? That changes cash timing.

priya.s: partner prefers MDF as an upfront credit applied against first invoice to speed enablement.

sam.legal: if MDF is upfront credit we need contract language for clawback if commitments are not met. Also want to confirm no data-sharing exclusivity or transfer terms. I'll draft a clause.

martin.dealdesk: Claire + Sam — provisional ask: approve temporary margin uplift to 18% for 6 months tied to LOI for 100k ARR and signed MDF T&C (clawback clause). After 6 months, revert to standard partner matrix unless commit converted to >=200k ARR. Can finance sign off on the provisional path?

claire.finance: I can sign off on provisional 6-month uplift provided: (1) MDF is structured as a repayable credit if commit not met, (2) we cap MDF exposure at $20k, (3) Sales records a forecast and we get monthly burn report.

martin.dealdesk: good. I'll draft the special terms and route to legal for insertion.

jenna.se: for POC access — security asked for completed SCQ + IP address allowlist. Orbit says they can provide a SOC2 report but wants a compressed timeline. @ops-bot any ETA from security for SCQ review?

ops-bot: Security intake acknowledged ORB-2026. Target response: 5 business days. Please attach completed SCQ to the intake ticket.

alex.p: action items: (1) Priya to secure LOI for 100k ARR (2) Jenna to coordinate SCQ + sandbox access (3) Martin to draft deal-desk special terms with MDF clawback (4) Sam to add contractual clawback language (5) Claire to confirm MDF cap in deal desk doc. I'll post the formal approval request when docs are ready.

priya.s: on it — will ping Orbit today for LOI.

sam.legal: I'll draft the clawback + MDF T&C and share for review in this thread.

martin.dealdesk: once I have the draft, I'll run econ and attach a one-pager for CRO signoff. If CRO agrees, we'll route to finance for final pricing approval.

alex.p: thanks all. tagging for visibility @martin.dealdesk @claire.finance @sam.legal — plan to submit to deal desk by EOD Friday if LOI arrives. :+1:

claire.finance: noted. please include the forecast model.

ops-bot: Reminder: please attach all artifacts (LOI, SCQ, rate-card) to ticket ORB-2026 before routing to procurement.

alex.p: will do. thanks everyone.
summary: Request for reseller margin uplift (Orbit Labs): 18% reseller margin + 10% MDF. Team agreed provisional 6-month uplift tied to 100k LOI, MDF clawback, SCQ for POC. Action items assigned to sales, deal desk, legal, finance, and security.
